values.note: Over 100 electric sites, 30 or 50 amp. Most sites have no hookup, and none has water or sewer.

values.note: 193 non-electric and 96 electric reservable sites, nearly all rated 23 ft or more; all back-in on gravel.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233553 ('295 sites') + RIDB catalog (289 reservable standard sites, 286 rated 23+ ft, longest 81 ft, all back-in), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Reservation only, but same-day reservations can be made. Check-in 3 PM, check-out 1 PM. Maximum 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Golf carts prohibited.
